r:
Generate a grub config file

-o, --output=FILE
output generated config to FILE [default=stdout]
--no-grubenv-update
do not update variables in the grubenv file
--update-bls-cmdline
overwrite BLS cmdline args with default args
-h, --help
print this message and exit
-V, --version
print the version information and exit

grub-install(8)

The full documentation for grub-mkconfig is maintained as a Texinfo manual. If the info and grub-mkconfig programs are properly installed at your site, the command

info grub-mkconfig

should give you access to the complete manual.
